title: SignalOS: Integrations
summary: Connect drives and records to terminals, missions, index search, maps, and tutorial prompts.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Terminal hosts SignalOS surfaces, Wiki can summarize records, Index can expose data objects, and styled screens can make records easier to read when present.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Terminal as the host surface, Wiki for summaries, Index for data objects, and ScreenCore styling when present for clearer records.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: Without linked apps, keep drives named, records sorted, and important coordinates or warnings copied into your route notes.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
